value.rationale: Fixed-radius molecular detectors shrink naturally toward a point-like birth site. The result identifies an all-order structural Brownian recurrence cutoff d*k=2, determines precise logarithmic and saturation coefficients, exhibits mortality-independent ultraviolet amplitudes, proves a fixed-off-source contrasting volume law, and gives exact physical 2D pair-correlation and 3D mean-occupation constants. This is more than a numerical special case or restatement of the one-body mean density; it is a motivated microscopic cluster-intermittency classification.
